name: Rolen Standard Straight Denim
description: Mid-rise straight-leg jeans in classic indigo denim, worn soft through the thighs and knees. Five-pocket construction with flat-riveted stress points. No frills, no tech — just a well-cut pair of jeans that holds up to daily wear in M88's lower tiers.
what_it_says: You buy practical and you don't overthink it. You've had this pair for two years and it still fits.
story_hooks: A faded stamp inside the waistband reads a batch number tied to a recalled lot — something the corponation never publicly acknowledged.
The buyer finds a previous owner's locker code written in marker on the inner hem.

physical_description.visual_profile: Timeless straight-leg silhouette with a relaxed yet structured appearance. Classic five-pocket construction visible on front and back. The indigo fading through high-wear areas creates a lived-in character that reads authentically worn rather than artificially distressed.
physical_description.fit: Mid-rise with a straight leg from hip to ankle. Not tight, not baggy — engineered for functionality and comfort during long shifts. Sits naturally at the waist without requiring adjustment.
physical_description.primary_material: Heavy-weight indigo denim, 100% cotton or cotton-blend synthetic. Durable enough to resist snags from industrial environments and rough handling.
physical_description.texture: Tightly woven with a subtle diagonal twill weave visible up close. The thighs and knees show soft, fabric-worn texture from repeated movement and washing. Edges remain crisp at seams and pocket openings.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep indigo base with significant fading through the thighs, knees, and inner seams where friction occurs. Contrast white stitching throughout; flat metal rivets at pocket corners.
physical_description.closures: Button fly with traditional five-point rivet reinforcement at stress points. Simple metal button and single-loop belt pass.
distinctive_features: Flat-riveted stress points at all pocket corners — standard durability marker
No integrated tech, AR panels, or augmentation mounts
Minimal branding — small woven Rolen label at back waistband only
Authentic wear patterns on thighs and knees from actual use, not factory distressing
Selvedge edge visible on inseam (optional detail)
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3-4 working class. Not luxury, not salvage — reliable everyday wear for people whose income depends on gear that doesn't fail.
physical_description.cultural_context: Factory workers, warehouse crew, maintenance technicians, street engineers. The uniform of someone who works with their hands in the lower Metropolitan zones. No affectation, no status signaling — just practical.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in and well-worn. Fading is natural from months of use, not chemical treatment. May show minor repairs at stress points. Still structurally sound.
